judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core Ajv validation in `ToolRegistry` and passes a few acceptance tests, but appears to have stopped mid-implementation. Under TypeScript `NodeNext`/ESM module resolution, `import Ajv from 'ajv'` and `catch (err: any)` / `as any` in `registry.ts` and `registry.test.ts` will fail `npm run typecheck` and `npm run eslint`. Most of the required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra property passthrough, dynamic schema changes, unknown tool error, compilation count) and the test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, while an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` and `.lore/dod.md` were left behind. Finally, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were performed, which will also cause CI changelog checks to fail.
